concept.title: Step 4: draft names and definitions
concept.shortdesc: An AI model drafts a name, a definition and the boundaries for each group by comparing it with its neighbours.

conbody.p: For each group, an AI model is shown typical members, borderline members and the neighbouring groups. It drafts:

ul.li: a list of what the category includes
a list of what it excludes, with a pointer to where those things belong instead

conbody.p: Comparing each group with its neighbours is what produces useful boundaries.
The model used for this step is Claude. It is used only for this step and for testing, and only on cleaned text.
